# Eagle Pubs

> > Eagle Pubs is Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University's open educational resource publishing platform powered by Pressbooks, offering Creative Commons-licensed textbooks and interactive learning materials.

Eagle Pubs provides a centralized catalog of peer-reviewed open textbooks and OER materials developed by ERAU faculty and subject matter experts. The platform supports academic publishing, book adoption, and accessible educational content across aviation, engineering, business, and STEM disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Open Educational Resources (OER)
- Pressbooks Platform

## Getting Started

- [Eagle Pubs Homepage](https://eaglepubs.erau.edu): Homepage for Eagle Pubs, ERAU's open educational resource publishing platform
- [About Eagle Pubs](https://eaglepubs.erau.edu/about): Overview of Eagle Pubs mission, Pressbooks platform, and OER publishing services at ERAU
- [Help & Support](https://eaglepubs.erau.edu/help): Support resources including Pressbooks guides, FAQs, and getting-started tutorials

## Open Textbook Catalog

- [Catalog](https://eaglepubs.erau.edu/catalog): Searchable repository of creative commons-licensed open textbooks published by Eagle Pubs
- [Corporate Finance](https://eaglepubs.erau.edu/corporate-finance): Open textbook on corporate finance with Excel tutorials and interactive learning modules
- [A Self-Contained Course in Mathematical Theory of Probability](https://eaglepubs.erau.edu/ma412book): Open textbook on probability theory and statistics for junior-senior level STEM students
- [Mastering Enterprise Networks (2nd Ed)](https://eaglepubs.erau.edu/mastering-enterprise-networks-labs): Hands-on open educational resource covering enterprise networks and cybersecurity practices
- [Drones and AAM Across the World](https://eaglepubs.erau.edu/dronesacrosstheworld): Open educational resource on global drone laws and aviation regulations by Sarah Nilsson
